id: FILL IN: short stable id for this eval, e.g. rag-grounding
title: FILL IN: human-readable title for this eval

decision.question: FILL IN: the decision this eval exists to inform
decision.owner: FILL IN: named person or role accountable for acting on the result

domain.users: FILL IN: who is exposed to the system being evaluated
domain.operating_conditions: FILL IN: the conditions the system runs under in practice

items.source: FILL IN path to the item pool JSONL, relative to this card (e.g. items/pool.jsonl)
items.sampling_frame: FILL IN: where and how the pool was sampled

contamination_controls.canary: FILL IN: a canary string unique to this eval, used to detect leakage

dev.path: FILL IN path to the dev split JSONL, relative to this card (e.g. items/dev.jsonl)

test.path: FILL IN path to the sealed test split JSONL, relative to this card (e.g. items/test.jsonl)
test.sha256: FILL IN: sha256 of the sealed test split file, computed after sealing
test.sealed_at: FILL IN: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the split was sealed

grader.kind: FILL IN: kind of grader, e.g. llm_judge or rule_based
grader.model: FILL IN: model/version doing the grading
grader.mode: FILL IN: grading mode, e.g. pairwise or pointwise
grader.rubric_ref: FILL IN path to the grading rubric, relative to this card (e.g. rubrics/grounding.md)
grader.gold_set: FILL IN path to the held-out human-labeled gold set, relative to this card (e.g. labels/gold.csv)

preregistration.sealed_at: FILL IN: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the threshold was fixed
preregistration.content_hash: FILL IN: sha256 of the sealed protocol content

protocol.prompts_ref: FILL IN path to the exact prompts used, relative to this card (e.g. prompts/v1.md)
protocol.elicitation_budget: FILL IN: e.g. 3 attempts, best-of-n off

threshold.metric: FILL IN: the metric the decision rule is applied to
threshold.decision_rule: FILL IN: e.g. lower bound of 95% CI > 0.90
